patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed, high-contrast black background for the main content areas, with project showcases presented as immersive, full-width media blocks.
A single, bold, wide sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with dramatic scaling for the hero logo and consistent smaller sizes for navigation and body text.
The primary color scheme is stark black and white, creating high contrast, with a vibrant electric blue introduced as a strong accent color in the footer.
The oversized 'Molecular' logo in the hero section dramatically scales down and repositions to become a compact, sticky header logo as the user scrolls down the page.
Project showcases are presented as full-bleed video or image sections, each with a minimal, small text label overlaid, creating an immersive portfolio experience.

technique_notes: The initial hero features a large, static brand logo that transforms into a smaller, sticky header logo with a smooth, scroll-triggered scaling and translation animation. As the user scrolls, the original hero content scrolls out of view, and subsequent full-bleed media sections (project showcases) reveal themselves as they enter the viewport. The detected video-hero refers to a small, auto-playing video thumbnail within the initial hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold hero logo (~8-10x body) that scales down to a standard header size, with small, consistent body and navigation text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the initial hero, relying on vast negative space. Subsequent content sections are full-bleed, with minimal internal padding for text overlays.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic transformation of the massive 'Molecular' logo from a hero-level brand statement into a functional, sticky header logo upon scroll. This creates an immediate, impactful brand presence that gracefully transitions into a navigable interface.
